messages:
marie_support: FYI support ticket from ACME corp — their private VPC customers see websocket streams stall after ~90-120s. They call it a "silent hang" where no frames arrive but TCP stays ESTABLISHED. They say it only happens when traffic goes through their corporate proxy/middlebox.

devon_sre: Can you paste the customer repro steps and any logs they provided? Do we see any TLS alerts or TCP FINs on our side? :thinking:

marie_support: Repro steps they gave: 1) Connect to our hosted websocket `/v1/streams` from a client behind their proxy. 2) Start a streaming request that emits tokens continuously. 3) After ~2 mins, client sees no chunks/data; socket still open. They attached a small pcap excerpt showing repeating client TLS 1.2 application data then silence. No TLS alerts.

sam_eng: Common culprit is a middlebox doing TLS rewrap or idle-timeout + buffer flush. If the proxy buffers small chunks and only forwards on buffer flush or on full TCP window, you can get stalls. Also some TLS rewriters drop TCP-level keepalives. Ask customer to verify their proxy idle timeout and any TLS inspection rules.

marie_support: Customer sent this app log snippet from their client (sanitized):

```
[2024-09-02T14:12:01Z] ws.open -> connected
[2024-09-02T14:12:03Z] received msg chunk: "token..."
[2024-09-02T14:14:05Z] no data for 120s, app-level ping returned no pong
[2024-09-02T14:14:06Z] socket still ESTABLISHED, attempting reconnect -> succeeds
```

devon_sre: Can they run `openssl s_client -connect <host>:443 -servername <host>` while reproducing and capture the TLS `ClientHello` SNI? Also ask for tcpdump on their proxy egress to see if packets are being held or dropped.

sam_eng: Small mitigation: enable WebSocket-level pings every 15–30s (application ping/pong frames). That will usually keep middleboxes from idling out. On our side we should also support `sec-websocket-protocol: keepalive-v1` header for customers who want server-assisted pings.

marie_support: I asked customer to: 1) increase proxy idle timeout or whitelist our host, 2) capture pcap from client->proxy and proxy->internet, 3) test with `wscat -v` to see raw frames, and 4) enable app-level ping every 20s.

devon_sre: Also check their VPC egress allowlist: if NAT mapping gets rotated after ~120s, you can see apparent silence until a new mapping is created. Ask which NAT gateway and its idle timeout.

marie_support: Customer replied: their corporate proxy is performing TLS interception (enterprise MITM) and has a 2m idle reassembly timer. They can change to forward-without-buffering for streaming hosts. They're going to try decreasing buffering.

ingest-bot: Deploy note: no anomalies on our stream workers for that customer during reported window (latency and token rates normal).

sam_eng: Action items summarized:
- Customer to disable buffer-reassembly or raise idle timeout on the proxy.
- Customer to run tcpdump on both sides and send pcaps.
- We provide a short docs snippet with recommended websocket ping interval and example client code.
- SRE to monitor for similar tickets and flag by proxy fingerprint (TLS intercept + 2m timer).

marie_support: I'll mark the ticket as escalated to SRE and loop back once we have pcaps. Thanks :thumbsup:
